newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE spot white sugar ends lower but forwards fir.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE spot white sugar ends lower but forwards fir.

text.p: London white sugar futures ended mixed on Friday after mimicking the sudden swings in the New York market, traders said.

Nearby values managed to claw their way back from the lows in afternoon activity although the spot May contract saw a renewal of bearish sentiment in late trading while other forwards ended slightly firmer.
But further forwards all closed at the day's highs.
Earlier, New York's March raws contract, which expires in a week's time, slumped to 10.95 cents/lb on a combination of speculative and trade selling.
London then stirred into life and followed the downward trend but bargain-hunters soon dragged the nearby values higher into mid-range.
"It's stabilised somewhat but the whites didn't really take a battering," said one trader.
May closed down $1.50 at $309.50 after hitting an intraday low of $307.40 and August was up 40 cents at $310.70. Volume totalled a modest 1,095 lots.
